text:
Anna: Kickoff: ACME pilot — they want Optimize toolkit recommendations for batching/caching/quant + eval-triggered alerts. Constraints: p99 gen latency <=250ms, sensitive PII, model outputs must pass eval thresholds. Need to define pilot slice, launch gates, and minimal ops runbook by EOD Friday. Who can help scope?
Miguel: I'm in. What's environment? Hosted or Dedicated? Latency target suggests dedicated GPUs or warm prefixes. Also need to know seq lengths and typical prompt vs completion ratio.
Sasha: Existing telemetry shows ACME median seq 128, 95th 512. Batch/caching will help but quantization might push latency down but risks quality regressions on long tails. Suggest Q4-bit fallback policy.
Zach: Proposal: define a 2-week pilot slice: 1) 5% traffic on hosted, pinned model variant; 2) dedicated if latency breaches >5% of requests; 3) eval-triggered alert set: rouge/semantic-sim thresholds + human review trigger. Thoughts?
Anna: That sounds good. Need concrete launch gates. Quick checklist pls.
Sasha: Draft gates:
```- p99 gen <= 250ms sustained over 1h
- Eval concordance >= 0.92 on ACME prompt set
- Fallbacks for quantized variant: automatic fallback to float if eval drift >0.02
- Audit log enabled + KMS for keys
- Ops runbook for cache invalidation
```
Miguel: Ops knobs: adaptive batching (target latency window 30-60ms), prefix KV caching TTL 10m, quantization profile (int8 dynamic per-layer). I'll add config PR. Also need SLO alert thresholds in console.
Anna: @Sasha @Miguel can you own the config PR and the runbook draft? I'll align with ACME on acceptance metric granularity.
Zach: Customer ask also: eval-triggered alerts should support per-customer thresholds and quiet hours. We should include that in scope but mark as stretch.
Sasha: Agreed. Stretch: per-tenant thresholds. MVP: org-level eval alerts with per-prompt tags.
Anna: Timeline: draft config + runbook by Wed, pilot start Thu, 2-week observation, go/no-go review next Thu. OK?
Miguel: OK. I'll open the PR tonight and tag reviewers.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled for model-quant profile 'q8_agg' on staging @ 22:00 UTC
Anna: Thanks. I'll update ACME and schedule a short kickoff with their infra lead.
